author: Yffe
content: Editor #83 build+run BLOCKED on 3 NEW issues beyond the 3 gaps (the 3 gaps themselves are fixed + committed 5fd42f0). (B1) forge/src/check.rs gate_fn does not route fx-diverge fns to L1 — run's invariants verify in Verus but the §7 mutation battery rejects it L0 (WeakContract, kill 10/42): an event loop's ens result<=256 is inherently weak. A diverge fn should route to L1 like a boundary fn and SKIP the L3 mutation/strengthen gate. OFF-MANIFEST (check.rs) + a level-semantics DESIGN question (needs a .design/ note: 'a fx diverge fn caps at L1 — partial correctness, no termination, no mutation gate'). (B2) L1 borrow-after-move in ens checks: a fn that moves a non-Copy field into its result then names it in ens -> E0382 (move_left/move_right/insert_str). New L1 ens-emission class. (B3) L1 '' string literal -> &str not TString -> E0308. New L1 string-literal-construction gap. Request manifest re-authorization for check.rs + a .design/ note for B1, and l1.rs for B2/B3.
